title: Aoyagi Toya — Faith In Believing〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was just one surprise after another today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was.
I didn't expect to hear that Taiga was back in town.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only is he Ken's partner and one of the key figures behind RAD WEEKEND, he's a world-famous artist now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That alone was enough of a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what really took the cake today was...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I bet. The first time I heard him sing, I didn't really know what to do with myself afterward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No musical performance has had this much of an impression on me since...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The first time I saw Dad's concert...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He remained completely loyal to the original music. He never once improvised or added anything in.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Some would say that there's no fun in that, but he pulled the entire audience into a whole new world after playing just a few notes.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's world-class in every sense of the word. From his unyielding obsession to his actual playing ability...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I always figured that there were others in this world who could match Dad in terms of musical talent...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But to think that one of them would be in this city...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just... You seem pretty calm considering how surprised you said you were.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am. I meant every bit of what I said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I live with a world-class artist, so I may not have quite the same reaction as others when it comes to being starstruck.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that makes sense...
Then, I guess there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, it's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, it'd be great if Kohane does get to practice with Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it wasn't just today either. Between Kohane's performance at STAY GOLDEN to Taiga suddenly appearing, these past few days have been full of surprises.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I guess he was wondering if it was starting to be too much for me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But he has seemed more concerned than usual as of late...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh, no...
Let's get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, I know. Before we head over...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He really is keeping an eye out for everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A lot has been happening lately, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, just keep doing what you usually do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A part of me was expecting that, so I wasn't really taken aback by it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It may be that he won't tell me or can't tell me right now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But feel free to ask for help if you feel you need it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I will if it comes to that.
